Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.audio

Class AudioMixer

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.audio.AudioMixer
public final class AudioMixer extends Object
FFmpeg decoder plus deterministic sample-domain mixer. Memory is bounded to one second of output and one decoded stream per track. Music ducking uses measured speech windows. Mixed samples use a soft limiter; final loudness compliance still requires editorial QA.

      public int mix(AudioTimeline timeline, double duration, SpeechProvider provider, SpeechCache cache, Path workspace, Path output) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      * Resolves cached narration, verifies its duration and mixes all tracks to a WAV file.
      Parameters:
      timeline - independent narration, music and effects model
      duration - positive interval length in seconds
      provider - speech provider; tests can supply an offline implementation
      cache - content-addressed speech cache
      workspace - temporary directory for decoded audio intermediates
      output - destination file or delivery settings, according to this signature
      Returns:
      number of narration clips obtained from cache
